comment: Models of Pelli Instant. 'bundle': 'default' = shipped with the desktop app (scripts/fetch-models.mjs puts them in this folder, gitignored); 'gpu' = only useful with DirectML/CUDA (fetch with --gpu); 'maximum' = the optional Maximum pack, downloaded by the app into its data folder (fetch with --maximum for development). Every file is verified by cull-ml at load (this file is compiled into cull-ml). Every license allows commercial closed-source distribution. The files converted by Pelli (no upstream ONNX) are hosted on pelli.s3.fr-par.scw.cloud/pelli-instant/models/ (see models/README.md).

models.source: OpenCV Zoo, YuNet 2023mar (Shiqi Yu, Wei Wu et al.)
models.purpose: Face detection: boxes, confidence and 5 landmarks (eyes, nose, mouth corners)

models.source: Google MediaPipe Face Mesh V2 (face_landmarker.task, 2023-05), ONNX conversion by PINTO_model_zoo #410 (conversion repo folder licensed Apache-2.0: https://github.com/PINTO0309/PINTO_model_zoo/tree/main/410_FaceMeshV2)
models.purpose: 478 face landmarks on a 256x256 face crop; eye aspect ratio -> eye open/closed

models.source: Google MediaPipe Face Blendshapes V2 (face_blendshapes.tflite inside face_landmarker.task float16/1, 2023-05-03, sha256 64184e22...), converted by Pelli with tf2onnx 1.16.1 (opset 17) + finalize_blendshapes.py (I/O renamed, explicit Conv pads for CoreML)
models.purpose: 52 ARKit blendshape scores (eyeBlink, eyeSquint, mouthSmile, jawOpen...) from 146 of the 478 Face Mesh V2 landmarks (x, y); < 0.5 ms per face on CPU

models.source: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 (openai/clip-vit-base-patch32), ONNX export + int8 dynamic quantization by Xenova (transformers.js, model card license: mit)
models.purpose: Image embedding (512-d) for similar-shot grouping, text search and the aesthetic head. Used on CPU.

models.source: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32, fp16 ONNX export by Xenova (transformers.js)
models.purpose: Same image embedding in fp16, preferred when a GPU/NPU execution provider (CoreML, DirectML, CUDA) is compiled in and works; slow on CPU.

models.source: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 text tower, fp16 ONNX export by Xenova (transformers.js). fp16 chosen over int8: cosine to fp32 1.000 vs 0.90-0.97.
models.purpose: Text embedding for natural-language search (input_ids from the CLIP BPE tokenizer, 77 tokens)

models.source: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 image tower, ONNX export + int8 dynamic quantization by Xenova (transformers.js)
models.purpose: Image embedding (768-d, int8, CPU; cosine to fp32 >= 0.97, mean 0.992) for the LAION V2 aesthetic head and text search in Maximum precision

models.source: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 text tower, fp16 ONNX export by Xenova (transformers.js); same BPE vocabulary and token ids as B/32
models.purpose: Text embedding (768-d) for natural-language search with the L/14 image embeddings

models.source: Meta DINOv2 ViT-B/14, ONNX export + int8 dynamic quantization by onnx-community
models.purpose: Burst / near-duplicate embedding in Maximum precision: CLS token (768-d, L2-normalised) of the whole photo squashed to 224x224, int8 on CPU (cosine to fp32 >= 0.968); fixed input shape via session dimension overrides

models.source: Roboflow RF-DETR-Seg Small (COCO, rf-detr-seg-s-ft.pth sha256 6de3da31...), exported by Pelli with rfdetr 1.11.2 (opset 17, 1x3x384x384), weights stored in fp16 and cast to fp32 in the graph (fp32 compute)
models.purpose: Instance masks of people and animals (COCO ids 1, 16-25): subject region for sharpness/exposure without a face

models.source: RetinaFace ResNet-50 (biubug6/Pytorch_Retinaface @ b984b4b, Resnet50_Final.pth sha256 6d1de9c2..., = facexlib v0.1.0 detection_Resnet50_Final.pth), exported by Pelli (opset 17, dynamic H/W), weights stored in fp16, fp32 compute
models.purpose: Face detector for group photos in Maximum precision (boxes, score, 5 landmarks in YuNet order), 1280 px pass on photos where YuNet finds 3+ faces or a small face

embedded.source: LAION-Aesthetics Predictor V1, linear head for CLIP ViT-B/32 (nn.Linear(512, 1)); converted to 512 weights + 1 bias, little-endian f32, compiled into cull-ml
embedded.purpose: Aesthetic score (LAION scale ~1..10) from the L2-normalised CLIP image embedding

embedded.source: LAION-Aesthetics Predictor V2 (sac+logos+ava1-l14-linearMSE, C. Schuhmann): MLP 768-1024-128-64-16-1 without activations, collapsed exactly into one linear map (max |diff| 5e-7); 768 weights + 1 bias, little-endian f32, compiled into cull-ml
embedded.purpose: Aesthetic score (LAION/AVA scale ~1..10) from the L2-normalised CLIP ViT-L/14 image embedding

runtime.tokenizer: instant-clip-tokenizer 0.1 (MIT) with the OpenAI CLIP BPE vocabulary bpe_simple_vocab_16e6 (MIT), compiled in
runtime.onnxruntime: ONNX Runtime 1.31 (MIT, Microsoft) through the ort crate 2.0.0-rc.15 (MIT OR Apache-2.0), statically linked
